claims.claim: An Australian Tesla driver reached six hundred thousand miles on a Model S with only one battery change and one brake pad replacement.
claims.episode_span: An Australian Tesla driver has clocked six hundred thousand miles on his Model S with only one battery change.
claims.supporting_quote: clocked up 600,000 miles in his Model S 75D electric sedan, with just one change of battery

claims.claim: Weekly Optimus production reached several hundred units last month, up from a few dozen per week in the second quarter.
claims.episode_span: Weekly Optimus production reached several hundred units last month.
claims.source_title: Tesla's Optimus Output Jumps Tenfold, But Hand Assembly and Software Gaps Force a Lease-First Strategy
claims.supporting_quote: According to The Information, the electric-vehicle maker was producing several hundred Optimus units a week as of last month, up from only a few dozen per week during the small-batch testing phase in the second quarter.

claims.claim: Each Optimus hand contains more than one hundred screws that still require human assembly.
claims.episode_span: Each hand contains more than one hundred screws that still require human assembly.
claims.source_title: Tesla's Optimus Output Jumps Tenfold, But Hand Assembly and Software Gaps Force a Lease-First Strategy
claims.supporting_quote: Among the most stubborn bottlenecks is the robot's hand. To achieve the dexterity that Chief Executive Elon Musk has long promised, each Optimus hand and forearm contains more than 100 screws and other small components.

claims.claim: The national average for regular gasoline reached four dollars and forty-four cents per gallon as of September twenty-one.

claims.supporting_quote: Analyst Patrick De Haan said the average U.S. price for regular gasoline reached $4.44 per gallon as of Sept. 21, up 18.5 cents from the previous week and $1.28 from a year earlier.
